Delivery times depend on what you ordered:
• Hard goods (bee houses, nesting materials, accessories) ship based on the delivery option you selected at checkout (such as USPS Ground).
• Bee cocoons ship via FedEx 2-Day (free for cocoons) on the specific Monday ship date selected during checkout. While it is 2-Day shipping, delivery can occasionally take 3 to 4 days.
If your order has shipped and hasn't arrived by the 5th day, please let us know so we can assist!

What should I do if the tracking never updates?
If your tracking number is not updating, we recommend waiting 3 days, as packages often turn up or catch up in the carrier's system (for live bees, please check in the day after the expected delivery date).
If it has been 5 days since your order shipped and the tracking remains stuck, please share your order number and email address with us so we can look into it and arrange a replacement for you!
